Join our team and drive growth as you partner with clients to elevate their experience, identify opportunities, and deliver measurable impact. Position Overview The Account Manager will be responsible for driving revenue growth and customer satisfaction within an assigned region.

Work closely with marketing, product, and customer service teams to apply the Fortive Business System and strategically align on product offerings and deliver high-quality solutions that meet customer requirements.
Support the design and implementation of annual strategic growth initiatives.
Mentor and guide the Junior Account Manager to support development, strategy alignment, and successful execution of account plans.
Serve as a trusted advisor and thought leader to clients on best practices, industry trends, and the value of Landauer’s offerings.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, or a related field, or equivalent work experience

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff.

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place.

Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

At Square, we’re re-imagining how mid-market businesses grow. As an SMB Account Executive on our Outbound Team, you’ll bring Square’s ecosystem to new sellers across diverse industries by building, shaping, and closing your own pipeline. You’ll run sophisticated, multi-product deals from the first touch to final close — blending hunter instincts, consultative depth, and strategic execution.
If you’re an experienced closer who thrives in outbound environments, loves solving meaningful business challenges, and consistently delivers against ambitious targets — this is your role.
You Will
Own the full outbound sales cycle — from prospecting to negotiation to close — with mid-market merchants.
Build and manage a high-quality pipeline through cold outreach, social selling, targeted campaigns, and creative outbound strategies.
Develop multi-product solutions across Square’s ecosystem and tailor them to each merchant’s unique needs.
Partner with Business Development on lead flow while independently driving net-new logo acquisition.
Conduct high-impact discovery, demos, and negotiations with decisiveness across multi-stakeholder deals.
Act as a consultant and trusted advisor — seamlessly flexing across BDR, AE, and AM responsibilities when needed.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Implementation, and Operations to deliver cohesive solutions.
Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting accuracy in Salesforce.
Consistently hit and exceed revenue goals — monthly and quarterly.
You Have
5+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience with consistent quota achievement.
Proven success in outbound prospecting and net-new business creation (SaaS or fintech preferred).
Experience closing complex, multi-threaded deals with longer sales cycles.
Ability to build pipeline from scratch using targeted, strategic outreach.
Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills across phone, video, and written channels.
Strong consultative selling skills — diagnose business challenges and map tailored solutions.
A hunter’s mindset — resilient, creative, and driven to win.
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-first environment.
Advanced proficiency with Salesforce and modern sales tools.
BA/BS degree or equivalent experience .

This is a high-impact, quota-carrying field sales role focused on generating net new business across a portfolio of non-named accounts in Indonesia. You will drive ServiceNow growth through a channel-first model by identifying, engaging, and winning with the right partner for each opportunity.

You will be the quarterback of a virtual team across Partner Managers, Partner Marketing, Partner Pre-Sales, and Partner Excellence to execute a disciplined territory plan and drive pipeline from first engagement through to closed-won.

s.h: What you get to do in this role
s.t:
Territory planning and execution: Own and develop a structured territory execution plan across assigned non-named accounts. Prioritise accounts by industry, whitespace, and partner coverage. Build and maintain a healthy pipeline to meet and exceed quarterly and annual new business targets.
Partner-led sales motion: Collaborate with the Partner Manager Group to identify and select the right partners for your territory by country, industry focus, and solution capability. Co-develop joint account plans and co-selling motions with selected partners to drive pipeline creation and deal progression.
Demand generation with partners : Partner with the Partner Marketing Group to design and execute joint demand generation campaigns, including field events, roundtables, digital campaigns, and prospecting activities; targeted at your assigned account portfolio.
Sales cycle leadership: Lead opportunity qualification and customer engagement, leveraging Partner Pre-Sales support for discovery, solution demonstrations, and technical pre-sales activities. Maintain deal momentum from first meeting through to commercial close.
Partner capability development: Work with the Partner Excellence Group where needed to bring new partners on board or enable existing partners with new solution competencies relevant to your territory's needs; ensuring the right capacity and capability is in place to support your pipeline.
Pipeline and forecast discipline : Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records. Provide regular pipeline reporting, deal status updates, and forecast inputs. Participate in deal reviews and business reviews with leadership as required.
Industry and solution positioning : Apply strong industry knowledge to frame ServiceNow's value proposition relevantly for target buyers across your territory, spanning verticals such as financial services, manufacturing, public sector, retail, telecommunication, or technology, depending on your assigned accounts.

s.h: To be successful in this role you have
s.t:
Sales track record: 5 – 8+ years of quota-carrying B2B technology sales experience with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding targets. SaaS sales experience strongly preferred
Channel sales expertise: Proven experience selling through or with channel partners, co-selling, joint pipeline creation, and managing partner-led deal motions. Knows how to enable and motivate partners to prioritise your deals.
Industry knowledge : Strong understanding of one or more key industries in Indonesia (e.g. financial services, manufacturing, public sector, retail, telecommunication, technology). Able to speak credibly to business challenges, buying centres, and digital transformation priorities relevant to your territory.
Territory management: Experience managing a large account portfolio (80 to 150+ accounts). Skilled at segmenting, prioritising, and executing a disciplined territory plan to maximise pipeline coverage and conversion.
Platform and workflow solutions: Familiarity with enterprise SaaS platforms, ideally ServiceNow, Salesforce, SAP, or similar workflow/ITSM/CRM platforms. Able to position platform value at the business and IT buyer level.
Stakeholder influence: Comfortable engaging VP and C-level buyers. Skilled at orchestrating a virtual internal team across pre-sales, marketing, and partner-facing roles to drive deal momentum.
AI fluency: Leverages AI tools to enhance productivity, including pipeline prioritisation, account research, outreach personalisation, and sales forecasting. Able to articulate AI-powered product value to business buyers.
Indonesia market knowledge: Understands the commercial and cultural dynamics of selling in Indonesia market. Multilingual capability is an advantage depending on assigned territory.

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
We're looking for a driven, consultative Commercial Account Executive to spearhead DeepL's expansion across Italy , with a strong focus on strategic outbound business development.

This is an exceptional opportunity to leverage DeepL's world class brand presence and market position to proactively engage, educate, and build lasting relationships with new clients across this dynamic region.

You'll take ownership of driving the full sales process from initial strategic outreach to closing, playing a vital role in expanding our commercial footprint.
Being based in London, this role offers the chance to shape a high growth territory within Southern Europe .

You'll strategically identify target organisations, craft meaningful outreach, and partner with key decision makers in organisations up to 500 employees, seeing the direct impact of your work as DeepL solidifies its position as the go to AI translation and communication solution in Italy.

If you're energised by generating new opportunities, solving complex client communication challenges, and being part of a highly collaborative international team, we would love to hear from you.

Drive strategic outbound business development and territory growth
Lead proactive market expansion: Identify, reach out to, and build relationships with key decision makers across target commercial accounts in Italy.
Build and nurture a high quality pipeline: Design and execute thoughtful, tailored outreach campaigns across multiple channels using email, phone, and LinkedIn to generate new business opportunities.
Become a trusted ambassador for DeepL's products and an expert on Italian enterprise needs, tailoring conversations to solve real organisational challenges.
Guide prospects through a consultative sales cycle by qualifying leads, leading insightful discovery sessions, presenting tailored solution demonstrations, and closing deals.
Maximise value for clients by exploring upselling and expansion opportunities as relationships mature.
Seamlessly manage inbound inquiries alongside your outbound initiatives to maximise territory potential.
Achieve and exceed targets in a supportive environment
Consistently work toward achieving monthly activity, pipeline generation, and revenue goals.
Maintain accurate CRM forecasting and account insights to ensure clear tracking of customer needs, timelines, and strategy.
Collaborate closely with cross functional partners including SDRs, Marketing, and Product teams to co create strategies that drive regional success.
Qualities we look for
Experience and expertise
Proven track record in full cycle SaaS sales , with strong experience in proactive prospecting, pipeline creation, and closing new business.
Experience engaging and partnering with accounts up to 500 employees.
Strong alignment with consultative sales approaches by focusing on active listening, understanding client pain points, and delivering value.
Strategic, curious mindset with a strong sense of ownership over your territory growth.
Skills and attributes
Exceptional relationship building, presentation, and communication skills both written and verbal.
High adaptability and problem solving skills, comfortable navigating dynamic, fast paced environments.
Goal oriented and persistent, with a passion for initiating business conversations and creating momentum.
Strong team player who values collaboration, mutual support, and sharing knowledge across teams.
Fluency in Italian and English is essential.

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team's general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

Über uns
Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .
In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.
Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.
Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.
VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).
Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.
Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.
Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.
Dein Profil
Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2) , High-Growth Start-ups (idealerweise Business Development oder Sales), oder im VC-Umfeld gesammelt
Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation in einem relevanten Bereich (z. B. Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Energiewirtschaft, Entrepreneurship oder einem verwandten Feld)
Du denkst unternehmerisch, triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen und setzt klare Prioritäten mit Blick auf Impact, Skalierbarkeit und langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg
Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Start-ups, Energie oder Immobilien mit
Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten
Du strebst danach, die beste Version deiner selbst zu werden und suchst Umgebungen, in denen du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst
Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) – unser Büro ist unser Homebase
Du sprichst Deutsch fließend (C2) und kannst komplexe Produkte verständlich erklären
Deine Aufgaben
Mission der Rolle
Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Gründer Julius (CEO) zusammen und bist wesentlicher Bestandteil unserer Enterprise Unit.
Dein Ziel: Du überzeugst die größten Portfoliobesitzer von Mehrfamilienhäusern deutschlandweit von VREY. Dabei arbeitest du aktiv am Aufbau unserer Business Unit "Enterprise" mit und verkaufst selbst an Wohnungsimmobilien- und Genossenschaften, um Bedürfnisse tiefgreifend zu verstehen.
Mitaufbau unseres größten Wachstumskanals
Du bist einer der ersten zwei Vollzeit-Hires im Enterprise Team und arbeitest eng mit unserem CEO zusammen, um den Kanal effizient und reproduzierbar zu machen
Du unterstützt den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung des Teams
Du akquirierst Kunden und denkst dabei bereits in langfristigen Partnerschaften und skalierbaren Systemen
Business Development & kommerzielle Exzellenz
Du arbeitest eng mit dem Enterprise Lead und unserem Growth-Team zusammen, um fortlaufend GTM-Hypothesen zu testen und erfolgreiche Modelle schnell zu skalieren
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Pipeline, Abschlüsse und Umsatzbeiträge
Du bringst Ideen ein, testest diese Hands-on und hast einen starken Fokus auf Execution
Unterstützung bei Lead Generation und Revenue Operations
Du unterstützt bei RevOps Prozessen, die mit unserem Wachstum mithalten
Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Enterprise-Praktikanten zusammen, um eine repetitive Lead Engine zu etablieren
Du hilfst beim Aufbau einfacher, effektiver Strukturen (z. B. CRM, Reporting, Automatisierungen), die uns schneller und besser machen

Vergütung: Kompetitives Gehalt und Anteile am Unternehmen
Startdatum: so bald wie möglich, unbefristet
Team & Benefits: Lustiges Team, Tech Budget von 2 Tsd.€, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket
Weitere Vorteile: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten
Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Bei uns entstehen keine endlosen Slide-Decks oder rein theoretische Modelle – wir bauen ein Unternehmen und machen tagtäglich einen großen Schritt nach vorne. Wenn du von Tag 1 an etwas Großem mitgestalten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.
Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss
Bei VREY sind wir davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt uns als Unternehmen und Gesellschaft stärkt . Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen.
Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, zögere nicht, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Wenn du von unserer Mission begeistert bist und glaubst, einen Beitrag leisten zu können, möchten wir von dir hören!
Der beste Weg ist eine warme Intro: Kennst du jemand, der auf diese Rolle passt? Empfiehl die Person und erhalte 3.000€ bei erfolgreicher Einstellung.
Voraussetzung: Die Person ist uns noch nicht bei uns im Prozess und wird offiziell vorgeschlagen. Auszahlung nach bestandener Probezeit. Bei mehrfacher Nennung zählt die erste eingegangene Empfehlung.

s.h: So, What's the role all about?
s.t:
We're looking for an experienced Enterprise Account Executive to join our expanding DACH Sales team and help us revolutionize the industry. In this role, you'll collaborate with potential customers to learn about their needs and objectives, and determine how Cognigy can assist them.
How will you make an impact?
Acquiring new enterprise companies from all industries within the DACH region
Building and maintaining an effective pipeline by self-directed prospecting, as well as working with internal, Business Development Representative resources
Developing, maintaining and reviewing territory plans that outline how you will meet business goals
Running full sales cycles from account planning & targeted prospecting through discovery/qualification, contract negotiation & close
Taking a consultative, value-centric approach with senior executives to map value, develop effective business cases, build ROI models and drive Digital Transformation conversations
Coordinating responses to RFPs/RFIs
Taking a collaborative approach to working closely with various team members including BDRs, Presales support, Marketing, Product, Finance and Leadership
Representing Cognigy at trade fairs or events that are customary in the industry
Preparing, presenting and conducting demos, presentations and customer meetings
Using CRM effectively and consistently to track sales cycles/engagement
Have you got what it takes?
You are an experienced Enterprise Sales Executive with a proven track record of success in selling SaaS within the wider Contact Center or Conversational AI environment
You have a hunter mentality and are passionate about winning and being part of an exciting company in a hyper-growth phase
You are confident navigating sales cycles with all management levels (particularly SVP/C-Level)
Organization and prioritizing are at the heart of everything you do and you are disciplined and function well in a remote environment
What is a salesperson without professional communication skills, and a customer-centric, personable demeanor?!
You can balance driving a sales cycle independently while leveraging internal resources
You are comfortable leveraging a partner channel to support the sales process
Fluent in German and English

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. About Halter
At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences.

Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance.

Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.
We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures .
To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram .

This is a rare opportunity to be one of Halter's first Regional Sales Managers in Argentina — one of the world's great cattle nations — building our customer presence in the region from the ground up.
We're looking for a go-getter who is out in the field, meeting farmers, championing Halter and converting them into our very first local customers. A 'never give up attitude' is crucial for this role; as our first sales hire on the ground, you will be a foundational contributor to the growth and success of Halter in Argentina.
You'll be responsible for using your strong sales background to drive end-to-end sales, from cold calling and on-farm meetings to deeply understanding our customers' farm systems. You'll detail Halter's value proposition, progress the sale, and ultimately close the deal.

As the region scales, you'll help shape how we set quotas and commissions, build sales capability, and mentor the team that follows you. Make your mark with Halter and help us push the boundaries of farming, connecting animals and humans like never before.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals/introductions, industry events and other channels, as well as fielding and responding to inbound inquiries.
Meeting high growth sales targets by managing pipeline through to close, including screening, qualifying, executing on-farm demonstrations and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.
Laying the groundwork for the local sales function — helping to set and manage quotas, commissions and other sales management tasks as the team grows.
Coaching, mentoring and developing future sales staff to help drive their professional growth and reach targets as we scale the region.
Collaborating with Customer Success to ensure successful post-sales handoff, implementations, customer satisfaction and account renewal.
Providing support, insight and communication to help build and foster trusting and enduring relationships with customers as they wait for deployment.
Leveraging opportunities and participating in relevant industry/Halter events and demonstrations.
Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand in a brand-new market.
Focusing on the customer and their needs, providing feedback to help drive the product roadmap.
Working with the team to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient and more predictable as the company scales.

A complete end-to-end sales skill set with at least five years of experience.
Proven track records and examples of successfully sourcing new prospects, securing meetings with new leads and creating new sales opportunities.
Someone highly experienced in value-based sales with a proven history of closing deals and high-volume sales results.
Well-prepared with solid communication skills to present Halter's value proposition.
Experience in beef farming or within the agricultural sector is highly desirable.
A person who is results-driven, highly motivated with exceptional time management skills.
Adaptability in a high-stakes sales environment and the ability to think on your feet — comfort with the ambiguity of building in a new market is a big plus.

s.h: Sales experience in the technology-based industry is preferred.
s.t:
Fluency in Spanish, with professional working English to collaborate across our global team.
A university degree or equivalent would be excellent but not a must.
Halter in Argentina
Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.
Join our team
Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement.

If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!
If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!
Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram .

s.h: Why our team loves working at Halter
s.t:
Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.
Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.
You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.
This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

We're looking for a go-getter who is out in the field, meeting farmers, championing Halter and converting them into our very first local customers. A 'never give up attitude' is crucial for this role; as our first sales hire on the ground, you will be a foundational contributor to the growth and success of Halter in Uruguay.
You'll be responsible for using your strong sales background to drive end-to-end sales, from cold calling and on-farm meetings to deeply understanding our customers' farm systems. You'll detail Halter's value proposition, progress the sale, and ultimately close the deal.

As the region scales, you'll help shape how we set quotas and commissions, build sales capability, and mentor the team that follows you. Make your mark with Halter and help us push the boundaries of farming, connecting animals and humans like never before.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals/introductions, industry events and other channels, as well as fielding and responding to inbound inquiries.
Meeting high growth sales targets by managing pipeline through to close, including screening, qualifying, executing on-farm demonstrations and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.
Laying the groundwork for the local sales function — helping to set and manage quotas, commissions and other sales management tasks as the team grows.
Coaching, mentoring and developing future sales staff to help drive their professional growth and reach targets as we scale the region.
Collaborating with Customer Success to ensure successful post-sales handoff, implementations, customer satisfaction and account renewal.
Providing support, insight and communication to help build and foster trusting and enduring relationships with customers as they wait for deployment.
Leveraging opportunities and participating in relevant industry/Halter events and demonstrations.
Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand in a brand-new market.
Focusing on the customer and their needs, providing feedback to help drive the product roadmap.
Working with the team to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient and more predictable as the company scales.

A complete end-to-end sales skill set with at least five years of experience.
Proven track records and examples of successfully sourcing new prospects, securing meetings with new leads and creating new sales opportunities.
Someone highly experienced in value-based sales with a proven history of closing deals and high-volume sales results.
Well-prepared with solid communication skills to present Halter's value proposition.
Experience in beef farming or within the agricultural sector is highly desirable.
A person who is results-driven, highly motivated with exceptional time management skills.
Adaptability in a high-stakes sales environment and the ability to think on your feet — comfort with the ambiguity of building in a new market is a big plus.

s.h: Sales experience in the technology-based industry is preferred.
s.t:
Fluency in Spanish, with professional working English to collaborate across our global team.
A university degree or equivalent would be excellent but not a must.
Halter in Uruguay
This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.
Join our team
Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement.

If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!
If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!
Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram .

s.h: Why our team loves working at Halter
s.t:
Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.
Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.
You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.
This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung
Unterfranken zählt zu den wirtschaftsstärksten Gesundheitsregionen Deutschlands – und zu den Märkten, die Digitalisierung am dringendsten brauchen. Wir bei Doctolib machen diesen Wandel möglich: mit einer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung, die Healthcare Professionals entlastet und Patient:innen bessere Versorgung bringt – Praxis für Praxis.
Als Account Executive SaaS / B2B (x/f/m) führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business: von der strategischen Marktbearbeitung bis zum kontinuierlichen Umsatzwachstum. Deine Mission: Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams in Unterfranken für Doctolib zu begeistern, nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum voranzutreiben und Deine Region zu einem der stärksten Märkte Deutschlands zu entwickeln. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.
Deine Aufgaben
Territory Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Du trägst die vollständige Verantwortung für Dein Vertriebsgebiet – von der Marktanalyse über gezielte Akquise bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Du entscheidest, wie Du Deine Energie einsetzt, um maximalen Impact zu erzielen.
Nachhaltiges Umsatz- und Pipelinewachstum: Du verantwortest Deinen Erfolg, Deine Pipeline und Dein Netzwerk in der Region – und Du weißt, wie Du alle drei systematisch aufbaust und konsequent entwickelst.
Stärke im Neukundengeschäft: Du verstehst, was Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams bewegt – und machst dieses Verständnis zu Deinem stärksten Argument. Du akquirierst zielgerichtet, pitchst mit Überzeugung und bringst Deals konsequent zum Abschluss.
Datengetriebene Vertriebssteuerung: Du misst Deine Performance konsequent mit Salesforce, analysierst Deine Kennzahlen, erkennst Muster früh und steuerst gezielt nach.
Dein Profil
Wenn Du nicht jeden der folgenden Punkte erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass diese Stelle zu Dir passt – bewirb Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Perspektive!
Nachgewiesene Stärke im Field Sales: Du bringst Vertriebserfahrung im Außendienst mit – idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld. Die Dynamik komplexer Sales-Zyklen ist Dir vertraut; Entscheider:innen zu überzeugen ist Deine Stärke.
Neukundenakquise mit strategischem Blick: Du liebst es, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen – und Du gehst dabei nicht nach Bauchgefühl vor. Du analysierst, priorisierst und pitchst mit Präzision.
Begeisterung für digitale Transformation im Gesundheitswesen: Du bist davon überzeugt, dass smarte Technologie den Praxisalltag wirklich verbessern kann – und Du machst diese Überzeugung im Gespräch spürbar. Für Ärzt:innen, für Praxisteams, für den Markt.
Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du drückst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) aus; Deine Englischkenntnisse sind außerdem mindestens auf Konversationsniveau (B1).
Präsenz dort, wo es zählt: Du weißt, dass der größte Impact im direkten Kontakt entsteht – bei Ärzt:innen, in Praxen, in der Region. Ein Wohnort in Unterfranken (oder die Bereitschaft, umzuziehen), Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deines Vertriebsgebiets sowie ein Führerschein Klasse B sind daher Voraussetzung.

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.
This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response.

Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

Welcome to Glow25!
At Glow25, we unite beauty with science and cutting-edge technology – AI is a natural part of our everyday work. As Germany's leading collagen brand, we help people feel confident at every life stage and enhance their natural beauty.

s.h: These are our current challenges and future goals

After successful market entries in DACH and BeNeLux, Glow25 is now ready to make its mark in Italy. We're looking for a Key Account Manager Italy who builds our business in the Italian market from the ground up — managing existing partners, securing new listings and actively developing ranges and promotions.

Market Entry & Expansion — You build our business in Italy, with a focus on drugstores, pharmacies/parapharmacies, online retail and selected grocery partners.
Account Management — You manage existing customers and win new partners through compelling pitches and tailored product range proposals.
Promotions & Trade Marketing — You plan and coordinate promotions, point-of-sale materials and sampling campaigns together with the marketing team.
Cross-functional Collaboration — You work closely with internal teams across marketing, operations, regulatory and e-commerce.
Market & Competitive Analysis — You keep an eye on trends, spot opportunities and develop new distribution ideas for the Italian market.
Representation — You represent Glow25 at trade shows, customer meetings and industry events across Italy.

Several years of experience in key account management, ideally in FMCG, beauty or health
A strong understanding of the Italian retail landscape — drugstores, pharmacies/parapharmacies, online retail and grocery
Fluent Italian and English
Spanish is a nice to have (bonus if you can also work in/with Spanish-speaking partners or markets)
A structured, proactive way of working with a real hands-on attitude
Confident use of everyday tools: Google Workspace, Slack, Asana and a CRM system as well as AI
Experience with pharmacy / parapharmacy channels — especially knowledge of the specific mechanics, decision processes and trade marketing setup in that environment is a bonus

s.h: That's something you can look forward to
s.t:
Work flexibly, in the way that suits you best. Work when and where you’re most productive – with flexible hours and smart time tracking.
Home office? Done right. We’ve got you covered: receive a one-time €500 allowance to set up your perfect workspace.
Fully equipped from day one. Mac or Windows – you choose what works best for you.
Glow Card – your monthly treat. Get €50 every month to spend however you like – that’s €600 a year, just because.
Learning is part of the deal. Whether it’s our Glowcademy, dedicated learning time, or personal development support – we invest in you, not just in numbers.
Let’s Glow! Enjoy 40% off our entire product range – yes, everything.
Take a break – you’ve earned it. 30 vacation days + 1 personal holiday + up to 10 additional unpaid days off when you need a real reset. Oh, and New Year’s Eve? That’s a day off too!
Stay healthy, stay glowing. Our company health insurance reimburses up to €600 per year for extras like vision aids, alternative medicine, or dental cleanings.
Thinking ahead. After your probation period, we’ll contribute €600 toward your pension plan – and if you add more, we’ll top it up with an extra 20%.
Exclusive partner perks. Get access to discounts and special offers from top brands through our corporate benefit platforms.
Culture that truly shines. For five years in a row, we’ve been recognized as a Top Company on Kununu - proof of the strong, positive, and genuine culture we live every day.
Move your way. From workouts to wellness retreats – you decide how to stay active. Choose between Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.
Yay! You've made it this far!
But there’s one more thing we want to say: Don’t hesitate! Especially if you’re a woman, or from an underrepresented group. Even if you don’t check every box, we want to encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger – and the stronger our team is, the better we can fulfil our mission of helping people bring more energy into their daily lives.

Ease is hiring an Account Executive to help manufacturers improve quality, safety, and operational performance through our category-leading plant floor audit platform.

In this role, you'll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close, while partnering with some of the world's leading manufacturing organizations.

You'll join a growing team, sell a proven solution with strong market traction, and have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on both our customers and the company's continued growth.

Position Summary As an Account Executive at Ease, you’ll own the full sales cycle for enterprise manufacturing prospects, from first conversation to signed contract. You’re the first face these organizations see, and the impression you leave sets the tone for everything that follows.

You’ll build relationships across the org, from the plant floor to the C-suite, and you’ll understand the difference between the two audiences well enough to speak to both without changing your conviction.

In this role, you’ll work closely with Marketing, Customer Success, and Product to move qualified deals forward and hand off new customers in a way that sets them up to win. If you’re a hunter who also knows how to build trust, asks better questions than you give answers, and measures success by the deals that actually close: this one is for you.

Salary: $200k+ OTE What You'll Do:
Prospect, qualify, and engage enterprise-level manufacturing organizations. You’re not waiting for leads to come to you. You know your ICP, you know where to find them, and you know how to earn the first conversation.
Build and manage a qualified pipeline. The majority of it will be self-sourced. Quality over volume. Know what’s real and what’s wishful, and have the discipline to tell the difference. A clean pipeline is a credible pipeline.
Run discovery that goes deeper than features and functions. Understand what a quality or safety problem actually costs the people in the room. Not just the business on paper, but the plant manager who’s been dealing with it for two years.
Deliver compelling product demonstrations that are tailored, not templated. The demo should feel like it was built for that customer, because it was. Show them their world in the product, not a generic walkthrough.
Partner with Marketing and Customer Success to move deals forward and hand off new customers in a way that sets them up for long-term success. The close isn’t the finish line. It’s the starting line.
Stay sharp on the manufacturing landscape: the pressures, the priorities, and the language of the people you’re selling to. The best reps in this space earn credibility on the plant floor, not just in the boardroom.
Own the full sales cycle. Prospecting through close. Negotiate with confidence, manage multiple stakeholders across the org, and drive deals to a decision, in either direction. Knowing when to walk away is part of the job.

3+ years of experience in a closing role, with a track record of winning new business in enterprise-level accounts. You know what it takes to move a complex deal and you’ve done it more than once.
Strong communication skills, but more importantly, strong listening skills. You ask the right questions and know how to create space for the prospect to arrive at the answer themselves.
Competitive and accountable, without needing external pressure to stay on track. You set your own standard, and it’s a high one. You also know when to walk away from the wrong deal and redirect your energy.
A consultative approach to discovery. You understand that the personal cost of a problem is just as important as the business case. You know how to find both, and you know how to connect them to the people making the decision.
Genuine curiosity about the manufacturing sector. You don’t need to be an industry veteran, but you need to be the kind of person who wants to understand how things are made, where the problems live, and what keeps a plant manager up at night.
Comfortable managing complex, multi-stakeholder deals with long cycles. You know how to keep momentum without pushing. You build relationships across the org, not just with the person who signs the paper.
Proficiency with Salesforce, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and ZoomInfo.
About Ease Ease digitally transforms plant floor audits around the world with EASE. The enterprise-grade mobile platform combines simplicity and efficiency with powerful performance insights, driving quality and safety on the plant floor.

Industry leaders, including Aston Martin, Dana, 3M, Tenneco, and Samsung, trust EASE to facilitate and analyze millions of plant floor audits every year. With deployments in over 40 countries, EASE supports more than 25 languages, solidifying its position as a category leader for quality management, as recognized by G2 and Gartner.

About Halter
At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences.

Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance.

Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.
We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures .
To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram .

This is a rare opportunity to be one of Halter's Regional Sales Managers in Queensland, one of Australia's great cattle regions, partnering with another Regional Sales Manager to lead our rapidly growing team and customer base.
We're looking for a sales leader who builds capability in others: someone who can hire, coach, and grow a team of Territory Managers, set the standard for how we champion Halter with farmers, and turn the region's momentum into a scalable, high-performing sales operation. A 'never give up attitude' is crucial for this role; you'll be a key leader shaping the growth and success of Halter in Queensland.
You'll be responsible for leading your team's sales performance end to end, from pipeline and forecasting to territory strategy, running regular one-on-ones and ride-alongs so you stay close to the deals your team is running and can coach them through real farm meetings.

You'll set the bar for how Halter's value proposition is delivered, hold your team accountable to targets, and build the discipline and rigor behind a growing sales region. As the region scales, you'll help design how we set quotas and commissions, build a strong sales culture, and develop the people who join you.

Make your mark with Halter and help us push the boundaries of farming, connecting animals and humans like never before.
The role is based in Brisbane, with regular travel to central Queensland.

A complete end-to-end sales skill set with at least five years of experience.
Proven track records and examples of successfully sourcing new prospects, securing meetings with new leads and creating new sales opportunities.
Someone highly experienced in value-based sales with a proven history of closing deals and high-volume sales results.
Well-prepared with solid communication skills to present Halter's value proposition.
Experience in farming or within the agricultural sector is a highly advantageous.
A person who is results-driven, highly motivated with exceptional time management skills.
Adaptability in a high-stakes sales environment and the ability to think on your feet.

Meet high growth sales targets by managing pipeline through to close, including screening, qualifying, executing on-farm demonstrations and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.
Collaborating with Customer Success to ensure successful post-sales handoff, implementations, customer satisfaction and account renewal.
Providing support, insight and communication to help build and foster trusting and enduring relationships with customers as they wait for deployment.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff.

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place.

Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. Who Are We?
Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
The Opportunity
About Fern
Fern is building the enterprise agent layer for APIs and is backed by Postman, giving us access to a platform used by more than 40 million developers and 98% of the Fortune 500. We operate with the focus, speed, and ownership of a startup while benefiting from Postman’s enterprise reach, distribution, and API ecosystem.
As AI agents increasingly become the primary consumers of APIs, companies need more than traditional developer documentation. Agents require structured context, strongly typed interfaces, deterministic contracts, and reliable tools for discovering and executing API functionality.
Fern helps enterprises make their APIs accessible to both developers and agents through four connected product surfaces:
Documentation that organizes technical knowledge into structured, agent-readable context
SDKs that provide strongly typed, production-ready interfaces across major programming languages
CLI tooling that allows developers and agents to interact with APIs directly from their workflows
MCP servers that give AI agents a standardized way to discover and use API capabilities

As an Account Executive, you will partner directly with engineering and platform leaders to modernize how their APIs are consumed by developers and AI agents.
You will run consultative, technically rigorous enterprise sales cycles that guide customers through hands-on evaluations of Fern’s documentation, SDK, CLI, and MCP products. You will help prospects understand how Fern can improve developer experience, establish API governance, and create an agent-ready interface for their platform.

Own the full sales cycle. You will source opportunities, run discovery, coordinate technical validation, navigate procurement, and close business. You will partner closely with Sales Engineering to build tailored demonstrations and guide customers through detailed product evaluations.
Sell to technical and executive stakeholders. Your buyers will include VPs of Engineering, Platform and Infrastructure leaders, Staff Engineers, Developer Experience teams, and technical executives. You will need the curiosity and credibility to discuss API architecture, SDK quality, CI/CD workflows, documentation systems, MCP, and long-term maintainability.
Drive consultative enterprise deals. Fern is not a transactional product sale. Customers are often evaluating Fern as a strategic layer between their APIs, developers, and AI agents. You will help organizations quantify the operational and commercial impact of improving API adoption, reducing integration friction, and making their platform agent-ready.
Navigate complex organizations. You will build alignment across engineering, product, security, procurement, and executive leadership. Successful deals require strong multi-threading, clear business cases, and disciplined control of the evaluation process.

You have 4+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience and have owned opportunities from prospecting through close.
You are comfortable closing $30,000–$500,000+ ACV deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes.
You are a clear written and verbal communicator who can earn trust with both engineers and executives.
You have a builder mentality and want to help define the go-to-market strategy rather than simply execute an established process.
You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with significant ownership and limited bureaucracy.
You have sold developer tools, API infrastructure, data infrastructure, cloud platforms, or other technical enterprise products.
You understand how APIs are designed, documented, tested, and consumed, and can confidently discuss SDKs, GitHub workflows, CI/CD systems, CLIs, and MCP.
The reasonably estimated compensation range for the role is $200,000 to $300,000 OTE, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.
What Else?
In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend.

Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about.

We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year.

We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.

### Stellenbeschreibung ###
Bei unserem Kunden handelt es sich um ein kleines, dynamisches und erfolgreiches Unternehmen, das auf Kundenkarten, digitale Kundenprozesse und BPO-Dienstleistungen spezialisiert ist.

Der Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung und dem Betrieb massgeschneiderter Lösungen für anspruchsvolle Kunden, wobei Qualität, Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit im Vordergrund stehen.

Die Zertifizierungen nach ISO 9001:2015, ISO 27001:2022 und Goodpriv@cy unterstreichen das Engagement des Unternehmens für professionelle Prozesse, Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit.

Um das Team unseres Kunden zu verstärken, wird ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine selbständige, strukturierte und kommunikative Persönlichkeit als Key Account Manager (m/w/d) gesucht.
In dieser Position agieren Sie als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen den Kunden des Unternehmens, internen Abteilungen und externen Partnern. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, dass Kundenanforderungen präzise geplant, koordiniert und erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kundenbeziehungen, die Planung, Koordination und Überwachung von Kundenprojekten sowie die strukturierte Erfassung und Priorisierung von Anforderungen.

Sie übersetzen die Bedürfnisse der Kunden in klare Aufgaben und Prozesse, koordinieren die Abstimmung zwischen verschiedenen Teams und überwachen die Einhaltung von Terminen, Qualitätsanforderungen und Dokumentationsstandards.

Sie setzen Projektmanagement-Tools für Nachverfolgung und Planung ein, bereiten Projektbesprechungen und Statusberichte vor, wirken bei der Erstellung von Angeboten und Lösungskonzepten mit und unterstützen die Weiterentwicklung interner Prozesse.
Das Unternehmen wünscht sich für diese Rolle eine Person, die gerne Verantwortung übernimmt, professionell mit Kunden umgeht und sich in strukturierten Arbeitsabläufen sicher fühlt.

Zu den gewünschten Qualifikationen gehören ein Hintergrund in Betriebswirtschaft, Projektmanagement oder Wirtschaftsinformatik, eine Leidenschaft für die Koordination von Prozessen sowie Erfahrungen im Key Account Management oder im Kundenprojektmanagement.

Darüber hinaus sind gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Projektmanagement-Tools und digitalen Arbeitsmitteln erforderlich, ebenso wie ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten, Eigenverantwortlichkeit und Kommunikationsstärke.

Sie sollten über Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse und idealerweise weitere Sprachkenntnisse verfügen sowie Interesse an der Arbeit in einem KMU-Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und vielseitigen Aufgaben haben.
Ihr Arbeitsalltag wird geprägt sein von der engen Betreuung der Kunden und der Koordination bereichsübergreifender Teams zur Erfüllung der Projektanforderungen. Sie verwalten Zeitpläne, organisieren Projektbesprechungen, geben Statusupdates, verbessern kontinuierlich Prozesse und tragen zur Entwicklung innovativer Lösungen bei.
Unser Kunde bietet Ihnen eine dynamische, unterstützende Arbeitsatmosphäre mit vielseitigen Aufgaben im Projektmanagement, Kontakt zu spannenden Kundenprojekten und Entscheidungsträgern sowie viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Freuen Sie sich auf moderne Arbeitsmittel, ein innovatives und erfahrenes Team, flexible Arbeitsmodelle sowie gezielte Weiterbildungsmassnahmen. Der Arbeitsplatz bietet eine sehr gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr und attraktive Sozialleistungen.
Wenn Sie sich von dieser Herausforderung angesprochen fühlen und Ihre Fähigkeiten sowie Ziele mit den genannten Anforderungen übereinstimmen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

At Swiss Re, we're looking for a curious and commercially minded professional to join our Property & Casualty (P&C) Reinsurance Business Development team - where big ideas meet meaningful client impact.

As a Reinsurance Business Development Manager, you'll be at the heart of identifying and developing new business opportunities from EMEA clients within Swiss Re's P&C Reinsurance Business Unit. You'll blend analytical rigour with strategic thinking - generating ideas, analysing data, and presenting compelling reinsurance solutions directly to clients.

* Collaborate with underwriting colleagues to stay informed on Swiss Re's risk appetite and identify evolving client needs
* Engage in strategic client discussions on the value of reinsurance, drawing on knowledge of enterprise valuation, regulatory frameworks, rating agencies, and capital markets
* Contribute to the global P&C Business Development community - sharing ideas, best practices, and leveraging Swiss Re's global presence to drive results

Our team identifies client needs and applicable reinsurance opportunities, assessing their impact on client financial performance. We're a collaborative group of creative, inquisitive, and commercially driven people who seek out opportunity, explore possibilities, and bring them to life.

You're comfortable navigating complexity and ambiguity, and you bring sound commercial judgement to everything you do. Whether you're deep in a financial model or presenting to a senior client, you communicate with clarity, confidence, and purpose.

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

s.h: We have expanded from voice into three main platforms
s.t:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ElevenLabs is building its first dedicated Canadian go-to-market team, and this is a founding Enterprise Account Executive role based in Canada. We’re looking for an experienced, motivated seller to drive ElevenLabs’ growth in Fortune 500 and large-scale enterprises across Canada.

Working alongside the team led by our GM of Canada, you’ll help build our Canadian enterprise playbook from the ground up.

Our ideal candidate is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology, and eager to act as a strategic partner - enabling organizations to leverage our industry-leading models and product to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.
In this role you will
Build and manage a growing portfolio of new accounts across industries adopting conversational AI to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals
Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs’ conversational AI capabilities can drive user engagement, automation, or cost efficiency
Generate and own pipeline through targeted outbound into priority accounts, partnering with SDRs and our partnerships team to break into the C-suite

Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs’ voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, in-app assistants, and more
Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs’ presence within key Canadian enterprise verticals (e.g., financial services, public sector, telecom).
Partner closely with customer success and solutions engineering to ensure smooth onboarding and expansion of accounts.
Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating them on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents.

7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms.
Proven success closing seven-figure deals and managing complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.
Proven ability to self-source pipeline and build territory from scratch in a new or greenfield market.
Deep understanding of enterprise procurement and legal processes, with ability to accelerate deal velocity.
Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value.
Strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level.
Comfort with autonomy and ambiguity, plus the competitive, ownership-driven mindset to thrive in an early-stage, high-growth environment and build new playbooks, processes, and territory from scratch.
Passion for Agentic AI / Voice AI / Audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.
A hybrid of customer & product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction & scale
Bilingual (English/French) is a plus

Deshalb bauen wir die Ebene der Key Account Manager aus. Du übernimmst ein eigenes Team und ein eigenes Kundenportfolio — und gestaltest mit, wie Betreuung bei MAILODY in Zukunft funktioniert.

Aufgaben

Du führst 3–5 Account Manager:innen fachlich und disziplinarisch.
Du führst wöchentliche 1:1s nach klarer Struktur (Fortschritt / Probleme / Pläne) und verantwortest die Gesundheit deines Teams.
Du entwickelst deine Leute aktiv weiter — Schulungen, Feedback, strukturierte Einarbeitung.
Kunden
Du verantwortest Entwicklung und Ergebnis deines eigenen Kundenportfolios (Richtwert 6–8 Accounts, ausschließlich unsere anspruchsvollsten Kunden). Das Tagesgeschäft liegt bei deinen AMs.
Du bist geschätzter Ansprechpartner auf der Senior-Entscheiderebene deiner Kunden und platzierst Themen aktiv in Kunden-Calls.
Du erkennst Churn-Risiken früh, entscheidest die Gegenmaßnahmen für dein Team und drehst gefährdete Accounts zurück in Wachstum.
Fachlichkeit & Prozesse
Du bist die fachliche Rückfallebene deines Teams — Klaviyo- und CRM-Architektur beherrschst du in der Breite.
Du coachst deine AMs fachlich und baust ihre Fähigkeiten auf, statt nur Fragen zu beantworten.
Du ownst einen unternehmensweiten Prozess rund um unsere Mitarbeitenden (z. B. Onboarding oder Offboarding).
Du stimmst Standards mit den anderen Key Account Managern ab und teilst Learnings aktiv.
Qualifikation
Mindestens 3–4 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing oder CRM; davon idealerweise ein Teil in einer Agentur oder im E-Commerce.
Tiefe Praxis in Klaviyo oder einem vergleichbaren System (Braze, Emarsys, Bloomreach, Salesforce Marketing Cloud). Du hast komplexe Set-ups selbst gebaut, nicht nur begleitet.
Erste Führungs- oder Mentoring-Erfahrung— du hast schon einmal Verantwortung für die Arbeit anderer getragen. Das muss nicht disziplinarisch gewesen sein.
Sicherheit im Kundenkontakt auf Entscheiderebene— du hast schon mit Geschäftsführung oder Marketingleitung auf Augenhöhe gesprochen.
Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gutes Englisch, schriftlich wie mündlich.
Wohnsitz in Deutschland(steuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtlich zwingend).
Und was wir uns wünschen, aber nicht voraussetzen: Du gibst Feedback direkt und nimmst es genauso an. Du fragst nach dem Warum hinter den Zahlen eines Kunden. Du wartest nicht, bis dir jemand einen Prozess gibt.
Das ist nichts für dich, wenn …
… du Führung als Beförderung siehst und nicht als eigenes Handwerk, das man lernen muss.
… du Dinge lieber selbst machst, als sie abzugeben und jemanden dabei besser zu machen.
… du eine fertige Struktur erwartest. Wir bauen sie gerade — mit dir.

Customer Portfolio Management (~50%)

Manage day-to-day operational needs: support tickets, program inquiries, configuration questions, and status updates.

1 - 3 years of experience in account management, customer success, operations, business development, or a related field. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
Exceptional organization and follow-through. You keep track of everything in flight and nothing falls through the cracks.
Strong written and verbal communication skills: You write clearly, respond promptly, and represent Marqeta professionally in every interaction.
Analytical mindset: You're comfortable working in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, IF/SUMIF formulas) and enjoy using data to tell a story.
Process-oriented: You spot inefficiencies, document what you learn, and look for ways to make things better.

Team player: You collaborate well, build relationships across teams, and make the people around you better.

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
We're looking for an experienced, driven Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across the Nordics enterprises.
