In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents - our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents - to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.

Build and manage a growing portfolio of enterprise accounts across The Nordics
Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities - including ElevenAgents - can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency.
Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, building compelling business cases that translate AI voice technology into measurable business value for senior executives and economic buyers.
Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends - particularly as they apply to regulated Nordics industries
Demonstrate expertise - or a strong willingness to learn - about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs' voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, IVR modernization, and in-app assistants
Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs' presence within key enterprise verticals, navigating complex procurement and organizational structures.
Partner closely with Customer Success, FDEs and Solutions Engineering to ensure smooth onboarding, deployment, and expansion of accounts.
Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents.

7+ years of quota‑carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API‑driven platforms.
Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement.
Well-connected in the Nordic enterprise landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C‑suite and board level.

What is Leapsome?
Leapsome is the AI-powered people platform revolutionizing HR for modern teams . Leapsome drives HR excellence and empowers high-performing teams by automating, connecting, and simplifying every HR process across the employee lifecycle — from onboarding and performance management to engagement and development. Built with ease of use in mind, our platform ensures high adoption by employees, managers, and People teams alike.
Our purpose is to make work fulfilling for everyone , and our vision is to reshape the future of work by being the leading People platform for HR excellence and high-performing teams. We enable companies to create environments where people can achieve their goals, learn and grow together, and build genuine motivation & engagement.
Trusted by thousands of organizations globally, Leapsome secured $60 million in Series A funding led by Insight Partners in March 2022. This funding allowed us to further develop our intelligent platform, create exceptional employee experiences, and expand into the US market.
It’s an incredibly exciting time to join Leapsome and be part of reshaping the future of work!
Your Opportunity
Are you curious and eager to learn and grow? Looking for an opportunity to demonstrate and expand your skills in sales? Are you ambitious to create the best possible buyers’ experience? And, passionate to shape the future of work and continuous learning with us? Leapsome offers an exciting opportunity for driven and ambitious people to join our growing team in the heart of Berlin.

Full ownership and all the autonomy needed when it comes to the most critical steps of the sales cycle such as prospecting (including social selling), conducting platform demos, negotiating, and closing (including legal, data, and security).

Stakeholder Management/Relationship building.
Pipeline Management (incl. CRM data hygiene).
Accurate forecasting (incl. probabilities, priority, size, timelines, etc.).
Nurturing postponed/closed lost leads.
Being a product and industry expert (become/sustain needed for consultative selling).
Extracurricular activities (temporary assignments, e.g. OKR initiatives).
Your Profile
You hold a university degree and have 2 - 5 years of work experience in Sales (ideally in B2B SaaS) or a customer-exposed role, e.g., at a consulting firm.
You have a fluent/native level in German + fluency in English.
You excel at asking the right questions to understand a customer’s needs and decision process quickly, and you work with the customer to generate value for them.
You are AI-native, independently leveraging AI in order to maximise your ability to deliver a strong customer experience and streamline your internal process.
You are passionate about the future of work and continuous learning at work, and you want to join us in building an exceptional team and company to have a real impact in this space.
Bonus: You have previous experience in SaaS or HR tech, and/or organizational development, people development, or agility & digitalization.

Learning and development: Grow your skills with a €2,000 yearly development budget and full access to the Good Habitz platform.
Work-from-home stipend: A one-time €1,000 stipend to set up your home workspace.
Competitive pay and equity: Competitive salary plus a pre-IPO equity package, so you share in the company's growth.
Corporate benefits: Exclusive discounts and deals from our partner network.
Vacation: 30 vacation days a year plus public holidays, with the option to upgrade to 40 days at adjusted pay. After 5 years at Leapsome, take a month-long paid sabbatical.
Wellness benefits: Stay active with a fully sponsored Urban Sports Club M membership, and support your mental health with an Oliva subscription that includes 1:1 therapy sessions, plus company workshops on mindfulness and digital wellness.
Hybrid and flexible work: Spend 2 days a week with the team in our Berlin office, Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Impact: Join a fast-growing HR platform trusted by more than 2,000 companies worldwide: you'll help shape how companies run HR and grow their people in one connected system.
Culture: A diverse, international team that values open feedback and celebrates wins, big and small.
Sponsored lunch: Lunch is on us every Tuesday and Thursday.
Work from anywhere: Work from a different location for up to 2 months a year.
Monthly team activities: Join Feierabend , a monthly budget to get-together in Berlin — hosted by employees, for employees.
This role is based in Berlin and the salary range for this position is €55,000 - €85,000 + Bonus + Equity . View our full compensation framework here .
Leapsome aims to pay generously and fairly. If the listed range isn’t working for your situation, please tell us early in the process, we’d rather have that conversation than lose a great candidate over a number we may be able to address.
If your role or skillset isn’t covered in our compensation framework , it’s likely because we haven’t hired enough in that area yet. We’ll build a data-backed range before we make you an offer, and we’ll share our thinking with you as early as we can.
This note is published for transparency. It reflects our compensation philosophy as of June 2026 and describes our general global approach — it is not a contract, offer, or entitlement to any salary, increase, or bonus, and may change at any time. Individual compensation is always governed solely by your written employment agreement and applicable local law.
Leapsome’s values

s.h: We stay true to our values in everything we do at Leapsome.
s.t:
Impact is everything — We aim high, focus on the outcomes that matter and say no to the rest.
Speed is our advantage — We move fast with intent — simplifying, automating, and learning as we go.
Owners without egos — We trust owners and expect excellence in return. We take responsibility individually, support each other, and win as a team.
Candid is kind — We speak up early and respectfully. We assume good intent, stay curious, and care about each other’s growth.
Excited to be part of Leapsome? 😊
Just send us your CV. You won't need to input any information already mentioned on your CV later on - promise! 🤙
A cover letter isn’t necessary, but we’d really appreciate a brief answer to these questions: Why Leapsome? Why you?
We look forward to getting to know you!

If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
Help us make work fulfilling for everyone!
At Leapsome, we want work to be the best it can be for everyone. We help companies create environments where people can achieve shared goals, build authentic relationships, learn, and grow together.
Put simply; our purpose is to make work fulfilling for everyone. And we know how to get there. But we can only do this by “walking our talk” and building a diverse and inclusive company where people — not just the business — thrive.

About The Role Vivid Money is redefining how modern corporates, holding structures, and financial institutions manage and optimize their capital. From institutional-grade Treasury products (high-yield Interest Accounts, Money Market Funds, and ETFs) to multi-currency infrastructure and FX solutions, we provide the financial architecture that traditional banks make too slow and expensive.
We are expanding our institutional footprint in Germany.
We aren’t looking for a standard software sales rep; we are looking for a New Business Account Executive who understands the fabric of the German financial ecosystem. You will be employee number one on the ground, tasked with unlocking high-value segments: PE/VC funds, holding companies (Soparfis), family offices, and corporate service providers.
If you have the network to navigate corporate Germany, understand structured finance/treasury needs, and want the autonomy to build a market from scratch, this role is for you.
Your Mission Originate Institutional Pipeline : Identify and engage decision-makers across Germanys unique B2B landscape, focusing on PE/VC funds, corporate holding structures, asset managers, and corporates.
Leverage Channel Partnerships : Build strategic relationships with local multipliers—accountants, tax advisors, law firms—who manage hundreds of entities requiring modern treasury setups.
Navigate Complex Sales Cycles : Run the end-to-end commercial cycle for high-value accounts, from sophisticated discovery and structured treasury pitches to compliance onboarding and closing.
Position Vivid as a Yield Partner : Educate fund managers and corporate treasurers on how to leverage Vivid’s Treasury and MMF solutions to optimize returns on their cash reserves and dry powder.
Shape the German Playbook : Partner directly with the Sales Leadership team to refine our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), localized messaging, and regulatory positioning for the German market.
Represent the Brand : Act as the face of Vivid Money GmbH at major financial services, fund industry, and fintech events in Germany.
Your Profile 5+ years of B2B/Institutional sales experience within the German financial ecosystem (e.g., Private Banking, Corporate Banking, Fund Services, FinTech, or Treasury/Asset Management).
Deep local knowledge : You thoroughly understand Germanys financial structures (Soparfis, RAIFs, SICAVs) and know how these entities manage liquidity and banking relationships.
An established network : You have an existing book of contacts or a proven ability to network into CFOs, Fund Operations leads, Managing Directors, and Domiciliation Agents.
Technical fluency : You can speak confidently about FX, money market funds, yield generation, and compliance/KYB processes for complex corporate structures.
Entrepreneurial mindset : You thrive in an "AI-first," high-autonomy environment where the playbook is yours to write.
Languages : Full professional fluency in English and German is required.
Why Join Vivid? Hybrid or remote way of work. You can work from our Berlin office or fully remote from other locations.
Direct influence on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth.
Significant ownership from day one and strong growth opportunities.
AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
Learning & development budget to support your professional growth.
Fully paid vacation and sick leave.

Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.
Compensation range Total target compensation: €110,000–€120,000 gross annually (base salary + performance-related bonus). Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.
About Vivid At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.
Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.
Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.
We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making.

This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

s.h: Some practical things we expect from you
s.t:
You’re available full-time (40 hours/week).
You’re willing to come to our brand-new New York City office (Midtown Manhattan) for a min. of 2 days per week, or be in the field 2–3 days per week.
You live in (or are close to) New York City.
You’re available to travel to events - approx. 3 trips per quarter.
Your journey at Channable
As the hub of all tool knowledge, we believe that your training and onboarding must be thorough. You will participate in 2 weeks of training at our Utrecht office in the Netherlands to familiarize yourself with the tool and your coworkers. Rest assured, we will take care of travel costs and your accommodation. Given our passion for building relationships, you won’t have to spend evenings and weekends alone if you enjoy having people around.🥂
Your buddy will be there to support you and make your training unforgettable! 😊
Who are we?
Being part of our team means working with diverse and fun people who trust and help you along the way. Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, more than +40 nationalities, and a brand new and vibrant HQ in Utrecht, serving customers all over the globe. We're also operating from other offices including New York City, Berlin, and Aarhus.
Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. We like spending time with each other. Be that in the office, our Channabar, or in one of our internal chats. We’re open-minded and down-to-earth people. We’re super proud that everyone adds their own special spice to Channable’s culture.

Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at our Instagram , Facebook or LinkedIn ! Give our Culture Playbook a read.
What do we do?
Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

Real ownership of a growth market inside a profitable, scaling international SaaS company (not a cash-burning startup hoping to find PMF).
A defined ICP and sharpened strategy - you're not guessing who to sell to.
Accelerated commissions that reward outperformance generously.
Direct influence on GTM - your insights go straight to leadership, product, and marketing.
Collaborative international culture - 2 trips/year to HQ in Utrecht, Netherlands.
A product that handles 30 billion products monthly, is loved by customers, and keeps winning against bigger-name competitors.
Salary: Total OTE (100%) is between $ 200,000 and $ 250,000 gross annual based on a full-time (40 hours per week) employment. The bonus and base salary components will be discussed during the hiring process.
Onboarding time in Utrecht (NL): for 2 weeks to get to know the tool, our processes, and your colleagues. 😎 After that, you’ll get the trust and responsibility to show what you got. Your buddy will support you throughout the whole onboarding. ✌️
26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours. ☀️
Buying/Paying out extra holiday days: If you want additional holidays, you can buy up to 5 extra vacation days per year. Also you can get paid out 5 vacation days per year.
Annual L&D budget of $1.000 to spend on anything you want to learn. You can take full advantage of this to grow professionally.
401(k): Retirement plan with 5% matching.
Health insurance: Medical plan with the possibility to add dental-, and vision plan - 70% will be paid by Channable.

SUMMARY The Program Business Development Manager is responsible for identifying, evaluating, and advancing new delegated underwriting authority program opportunities.

This role requires deep understanding of portfolio-level underwriting performance, program structure, and risk management to ensure new opportunities align with the organization’s risk appetite and profitability targets.

The position plays a critical role in assessing program administrators, evaluating underwriting discipline and historical performance, and developing comprehensive business cases (PARs) to support executive decision-making. The role works cross-functionally to move vetted opportunities through the pipeline and into successful implementation.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Identify and evaluate new program opportunities through market relationships, brokers, and program administrators.
Conduct initial screening of opportunities to assess strategic alignment, underwriting appetite, portfolio fit, target segments, and distribution approach.
Lead due diligence of program administrators, including evaluation of underwriting practices, portfolio performance, operational capabilities, governance, reporting, claims practices, and third-party relationships.
Assess administrator alignment with carrier expectations and identify risks related to underwriting discipline, adverse selection, and sustainable growth.
Evaluate program opportunities from a portfolio underwriting perspective, including class mix, exposure profiles, rate adequacy, pricing strategy, profitability outlook, volatility, concentration risk, diversification benefits, and forms utilization.
Partner with actuarial and underwriting teams to validate assumptions and ensure programs align with enterprise risk appetite and return thresholds.
Develop Program Assessment Reports, including financial projections, profitability analysis, risk assessments, mitigation strategies, program profiles, and implementation steps.
Translate complex underwriting and financial data into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership review and approval.
Manage program opportunities through the full pipeline lifecycle, tracking milestones, dependencies, risks, and strategic priorities.
Support implementation and transition of approved programs by driving cross-functional alignment, developing execution plans, and ensuring launch readiness.
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE Relevant combination of education and experience may be considered in lieu of degree .
Bachelor’s degree in insurance, business or a related field is required.
Advanced industry certification such as CPCU, ARE, et al are preferred.

Minimum ten (10) years of Property and Casualty experience preferably in an underwriting and/or product development role.

Minimum of five (5) years of delegated underwriting authority capacity (carrier or program admin) experience; or prior experience/roles in where insurance portfolio evaluation was critical. E.g. Reinsurance underwriter, M&A underwriting.
QUALIFICATIONS To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES
Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Excellent presentation and facilitation skills.
Demonstrated leadership and project management abilities.
Ability to make competent, independent decisions with minimal supervision.
Ability and proficiency in the use of computers and Company standard software specific to position.
Deep underwriting acumen with ability to evaluate performance at the portfolio level.
Strong understanding of program structures, economics, and controls within delegated authority models.
Advanced analytical and financial modeling capabilities.
Ability to assess administrator quality, underwriting discipline, and operational maturity.
Strong risk assessment and decision-making skills in ambiguous environments.
Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff.

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place.

Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

Build disciplined execution that creates consistent, repeatable revenue outcomes.

Build repeatable plays for how this segment is won, from implementation and expansion.

Sprinto is building the next phase of its outbound sales engine and this isn't a traditional SDR role.

How the Banking World is Changing
The global banking architecture is undergoing a foundational paradigm shift. Traditional fractional-reserve banking systems and legacy settlement networks are increasingly constrained by T+1/T+2 settlement delays, operational counterparty risk, restricted operating hours, and fragmented capital efficiency.

As institutional finance converges with public blockchain infrastructure, capital markets demand programmatic, 24/7/365 settlement rails backed by total transparency and unencumbered reserves.

Operating under a Wyoming Special Purpose Depository Institution Charter, N3XT represents the next evolution of narrow banking—providing a fully-reserved, institutional-grade bridge between traditional capital markets and digital asset liquidity.
About N3XT
N3XT is a Wyoming-chartered Special Purpose Depository Institution (SPDI). We are a new, innovative bank designed to serve as the premier settlement and banking infrastructure bridging traditional capital markets and public blockchain rails.

Backed by elite institutional investors including Paradigm, HACK VC, Winklevoss Capital, and Pharsalus, we provide institutional-grade security, execution velocity, and total transparency for global B2B clients, trading desks, and market makers operating in a globally connected world.

Growth at N3XT is driven by market structure design, deep network effects, and high-value institutional execution. The Commercial team is responsible for introducing narrow banking and frictionless fiat-to-digital settlement to the world’s most sophisticated capital markets participants.
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Business Development Manager with a proven track record in institutional capital markets, trading infrastructure, or institutional sales to architect and drive our expansion across premier global financial hubs.
Reporting directly to the Head of Commercial & Growth, you will lead high-stakes deal origination and strategic coverage. You will operate at the intersection of US banking rails, institutional liquidity flows, and digital asset markets—engaging CFOs, Treasurers, Chief Investment Officers, and Heads of Trading to position N3XT as the primary banking and settlement partner for institutional capital.
What You’ll Be Doing
Institutional Origination & Deal Structuring: Lead end-to-end deal cycles with tier-1 and mid-tier institutional market participants, including market makers, quantitative funds, OTC desks, prime brokers, and high-volume institutional liquidity providers.
C-Suite Advisory & Treasury Solutions: Partner with client CFOs, Treasurers, and Heads of Trading to architect bespoke banking setups that optimize pre-funding requirements, accelerate fiat-crypto settlement cycles, and maximize collateral liquidity management.
Capital Markets Flywheel & Ecosystem Expansion: Scale N3XT ’s institutional referral ecosystem ("Meet me @ N3XT "), embedding our banking infrastructure into prime brokerage, custody, and trading counterparty networks to drive exponential network effects.
Strategic Event & Industry Representation: Represent N3XT as a subject matter expert at premier global conferences (Capital Markets, FX, and Digital Asset summits)—driving C-level bilateral meetings, keynotes, and rapid client onboarding.
Commercial Strategy & Pipeline Governance: Own revenue, deposit, and transaction volume KPIs. Utilize pipeline analytics and market feedback to inform executive leadership on product roadmap priorities and strategic market positioning.
What You’ll Need
5–8+ years of commercial experience in Capital Markets BD/Sales, Prime Brokerage, FX/OTC Trading, or Institutional Digital Asset Sales.
Institutional Capital Markets Expertise: Deep understanding of market structure, clearance and settlement mechanics, trade workflows, liquidity management, and prime brokerage dynamics.
Digital Asset & Crypto Fluency: Sophisticated understanding of institutional digital asset infrastructure—specifically stablecoin rails, fiat-crypto ramp mechanics, CeFi liquidity desks, and emerging tokenized asset workflows.
Proven Track Record of Deal Origination: Demonstrated history of independently prospecting, structuring, and closing complex, high-value institutional financial services accounts.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

Reach for the stars with us. Limehome is building something rare in hospitality: a tech-enabled operator that treats revenue not as a spreadsheet exercise, but as a full-contact commercial sport.

As we scale our portfolio toward 12,000+ units, we’re looking for a Senior Business Development Manager to build and drive the commercial engine of a dedicated cluster of properties.

This is a builder’s role: you’ll own a real P&L, spin up commercial projects from scratch — new B2B channels, GOPPAR optimization plays, OTA and SEM frameworks — and scale what works. The automated tech stack does the daily heavy lifting; you make the calls and build the playbook the rest of the portfolio will run on.
If you want to run a cluster like it’s your own — with the autonomy to test bold ideas and the data to prove they worked — read on.

s.h: How you’ll be hosting with heart
s.t:
Build & Scale Commercial Levers
Develop new commercial levers from zero to impact: GOPPAR optimization plays, personalized incentives, loyalty mechanics — test them on your cluster, measure hard, and scale what works across the portfolio
Build OTA product frameworks: crack where Preferred Partner, sponsored listings, visibility boosters and campaigns actually pay off — and turn it into a repeatable playbook
Run Ads experiments via sponsored listings: measure CAC against OTA commissions and steer spend to protect GOPPAR
Drive Local B2B Growth
Spin up local B2B as a demand-generation engine: identify, pitch and close the accounts that fill your cluster — corporates, hospitals, universities, contractors, event organizers
Build a non-OTA channel of direct stays you can activate whenever demand pacing needs a push; warm leads from the central B2B team are your head start, the pipeline and the results are yours
Own a Commercial Cluster to Test & Validate
Own commercial performance (RevPAR, GOPPAR) for a cluster of ~10 Limehome properties — your numbers, your calls and your playing field to solidify your ideas
Treat every lever — rate, channel, demand, cost — as something you can pull to move the bottom line
Cross-Functional Influence & Project Development
Develop, pilot and roll out new local growth initiatives end-to-end (e.g. personalized incentives, loyalty mechanics, local partnerships) – from idea to execution, without a ready-made playbook
Loop in central Channel Managers when your cluster needs a visibility push – OTA ads, content, campaigns
Quantify the commercial cost of ops, content or review-score issues and chase the right team to fix them — backed by numbers, not opinions
Flag the commercial impact of operational issues (e.g. a maintenance issue hurting your Booking.com score) so Ops can prioritize accordingly
4+ years in business development, commercial or revenue-driving roles : you’ve built and driven commercial initiatives, ideally in hospitality, serviced apartments, short-term rentals or travel-tech — though a strong commercial track record matters more than the sector
A builder’s mindset : you love taking an idea — a new sales channel, an SEM test, a pricing play — from zero to a measurable result, and you don’t wait to be told how
Commercially numerate : fluent with pricing, pacing and performance data; you measure everything and steer on evidence, not gut feel
Comfortable closing : when a project calls for outbound sales, you’ll pick up the phone and pitch — winning new business energizes you
Strong cross-functional operator : confident influencing without authority across Operations, Marketing and Distribution
Based in Munich or Berlin : this is a hybrid role out of our Munich HQ or Berlin office
Business fluency and English, German is a plus

Hospitality or travel-tech background : you understand occupancy, channels and how demand really moves
Comfort with an RMS / automated pricing : you’ve worked alongside pricing systems rather than doing manual data entry

Most business development roles hand you a target and a CRM. This one hands you a P&L and a blank canvas. You won’t just build a pipeline — you’ll build the commercial playbook for your cluster: the B2B channels, the OTA and SEM frameworks, the GOPPAR plays.

The automated stack handles the repetitive work; your job is to test bold commercial ideas, prove what works, and watch it scale. It’s a launchpad: this is the pilot for our new Commercial Owner model, so the frameworks you build here become the standard as we scale toward 2029. Build something — and grow with it.

Hybrid Office Model: We offer a flexible and empowering work environment - you can choose to work 100% from our office or partially from home and the office.
Visa & Language Support: We’ll support you during your visa process and with learning German on every language level after passing your probation period.
Relocation Support : We'll financially support your move to Munich if you live further away than 300km from our office.
Oneteam: We are #oneteam with a transparent company culture by staying up to date with each other through team stand-ups, regular All-Hands and suite events (Summer, Wiesn, Christmas).

Success in this role requires both domain expertise and an established network across the medical device, life science, and pharmaceutical landscape. 30 days - Deep product fluency across DataPRO RWE and ResearchPRO; has internalized PatientIQ 's business model, go-to-market motion, and the learnings from prior data buyer deals in the segment; mapped their existing network against active and target accounts; completed at least 3 introductory conversations with warm contacts; has built strong working relationships with key internal partners across clinical, product, and data teams.

Own your territory & build pipeline: Develop and execute a proactive outbound cadence (email, call, social) that generates ≥50 % of your booked opportunities.

Prior experience at an open-source or developer‐centric infrastructure company.
Familiarity with observability (logs, metrics, traces) or security analytics (SIEM/XDR) use cases.

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
Lyft's Airport Partnerships team manages the company's relationships with airport authorities across the U.S. and Canada, ensuring Lyft operates as a trusted, compliant, and collaborative partner at every airport we serve. The team is organized by region, with each Business Development Manager owning the airport relationships within their territory.

This role owns the Northeast region, covering U.S. states from the Northeast through the Mid-Atlantic and Carolinas, and Canadian provinces from Ontario and Quebec eastward.
As a qualified candidate, you're comfortable operating across a wide range of altitude — from negotiating agreements with senior airport officials to processing day-to-day operational requests like driver suspensions and fee changes.

You know how to build and adapt relationships with airport partners, whose working styles range from informal and high-touch to highly formal and bureaucratic, and you're equally skilled at translating airport needs into requirements that Lyft's internal teams — legal, compliance, product, finance, and marketing — can act on, and vice versa.

You are self-directed and highly organized, able to manage a mix of reactive, ad hoc requests and longer-term strategic projects without close oversight, and you take pride in being a collaborative business partner to airports while knowing when to push back.

Own airport relationships across the Northeast region by serving as Lyft's primary point of contact for airport authorities across the region's states and provinces, adapting your communication style and cadence to each partner's preferences
Deliver on airport requirements by coordinating cross-functionally with legal, compliance, product, finance, reporting, and marketing teams, translating airport mandates into internal action and Lyft's capabilities into terms airports can work with
Keep day-to-day operations running smoothly by managing the administrative and operational work required to serve airports, including processing driver suspensions, fee changes, and reporting issues
Operationalize new and updated agreements by managing the end-to-end process of launching new airports and implementing new agreements, amendments, and fee changes, making sure no step falls through the cracks
Balance short- and long-term priorities by self-directing across a mix of reactive, ad hoc airport requests and longer-term strategic projects, without close day-to-day direction
Build lasting trust with airport partners by showing up as a collaborative business partner rather than an adversarial one, delivering on airport needs within reasonable scope while knowing when to push back

Help make the world more hospitable
The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.
You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.
If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:
You'll own a Central-US territory, one of the company's fastest-growing markets in North America right now. Independent hotels and small groups across the region are still running on property management systems that weren't built for how they actually operate, and most haven't been shown a real alternative.
You'll take ownership of a defined territory covering independent hotels and small groups within our SMB segment (hotels that own and operate between 1-3 properties OR have rooms under 150 in their room count). You'll be the person who guides property owners and general managers through the decision to move off legacy systems and onto something that actually fits how they run their business.
What you would do
Build and manage a full-cycle outbound pipeline across your territory, with the majority self-sourced
Navigate multi-stakeholder buying committees, from property owners to general managers to finance leads
Run a structured prospecting cadence and keep your pipeline accurate and forecastable
Partner closely with business development representatives to convert sourced leads into qualified opportunities
Use AI to speed up account research and draft personalized outreach, adapting your approach to each property and stakeholder
AI Fluency Level 3: in this role, that means you've moved past using AI just for your own research and outreach drafts. You've built an approach to territory planning and personalized outreach that other reps could pick up and use, and you check every detail (property specifics, stakeholder names, claims about return on investment) before anything reaches an owner or GM's inbox.
For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to "AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates" on Confluence.
What you would bring
4+ years of full-cycle SaaS Account Executive/new business experience with a track record
A history of self-sourcing the majority of your own pipeline through outbound prospecting in a SMB or mid-market SaaS environment, not managing inbound or existing accounts
Experience closing deals that involve multiple decision-makers, not a single point of contact
Comfort using data (conversion rates, pipeline velocity, win and loss patterns) to manage your own business and explain your decisions
AI Fluency Level 3, or the equivalent hands-on experience redesigning how you use AI in your sales workflow

Experience selling hospitality technology, fintech, or payments SaaS, ideally against top competitors
Experience mentoring or informally guiding other Account Executives

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

s.h: No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy

Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
Participation in our company share program

Life at Mews
We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.
We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

s.h: A few things that define how we work
s.t:
High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

Welcome to On! As one of the world’s fastest-growing premium sportswear brands, On is redefining sportswear through pioneering technology, bold innovation, and a commitment to sustainability. Having already inspired millions of runners worldwide, we are looking for a Key Account Manager, Nordics (internally titled Senior Lead - Key Accounts ) to join us on a 14-month fixed-term maternity cover (target start: October 1, 2026).
In this role, you will be instrumental in accelerating On’s journey across the Nordics. You will manage a high-impact portfolio covering both physical key accounts and digital pureplayers, driving strategic planning and proactive order book management. You will report directly to the Head of Sales, Nordics, and work closely with our cross-functional teams.

We are the Nordics Sales team. Our mission? To drive growth and establish On’s market presence. We work passionately; forging partnerships and delivering innovative performance and lifestyle products. Inspired by athletes we are driven to do better. Always looking for new ways to support our customers in their journey to achieve their personal best.
You will join the Nordics Sales team and continue to accelerate On’s success in the region. The team partners with, supports and develops a variety of accounts across different segments, and has a real impact in growing and strengthening our regional partnerships. You’ll deliver a strong cross-functional way of working that brings the brand to life in the eyes of the consumer. establishing On as the #1 premium sports brand in the Nordics and beyond. You will report to the Head of Sales, Nordics.

Your role is to maximize On’s footprint and commercial performance across physical and digital key accounts in the Nordics. You will combine relationship management with sharp sell-in & sell-out analysis to elevate the consumer experience and drive sustainable regional growth.
You will work daily with the account stakeholders and the internal commercial team in a Nordic and EMEA level to deliver the brand objectives and targets.

s.h: Your primary tasks and responsibilities will include
s.t:
Physical Key Accounts: Own strategic relationships with major General Sporting Goods accounts. Conduct regular store visits (~30% travel) and partner with B2B Marketing & Brand Activation to ensure premium brand activation & product execution.
Digital Pureplayers: Lead seasonal planning, assortment curation, and online strategy for top digital partners. Ensure brand-elevating digital execution, optimized content availability, and strategic category expansion to maximize digital conversion and market share.
Sell-Out Data & Order Book Management: Proactively analyze multi-format weekly sell-out data and retail KPIs. Translate complex metrics into actionable insights to manage risk, capture opportunities, optimize inventory flow, and execute fast order book adjustments and replenishment.
Commercial Execution & Strategy: Deliver high-impact seasonal sell-in presentations and manage account sales budgets with rigor. Bridge global and EMEA strategies to local Nordic market dynamics, ensuring seasonal Go-To-Market (GTM) excellence and continuous revenue growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with B2B Marketing, Brand Activation, and Account Services to build integrated account activation plans and deliver high-touch customer support. Leverage influential communication to build cross-functional alignment and resolve complex account challenges.

Typically we are looking for around 5+ years of relevant experience; preferably you should demonstrate a proven track record in Key Account Management or Senior Sales within the sports or fashion industry (required to manage the fast-paced maternity cover transition).
Analytical & Technical Acumen : Strong proficiency in processing, analyzing, and synthesizing raw sell-in & sell-out data from diverse retailer formats into clear, actionable commercial strategies.
Digital & Retail Savvy: solid understanding of digital retail platforms (e-commerce homepages, consumer conversion) alongside physical store operations and visual presentation.
Account Portfolio Management: Experience managing major sports/fashion accounts (mix of General Sporting Goods physical retail and digital pureplayers).
Autonomous & Curious : A self-driven, proactive mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity, build strong internal relationships, and seek out information independently.
Languages: Fluent/C1+ level in English (mandatory). Proficiency in Swedish (strongly preferred) or Danish is a plus.
Must be based in or willing to commute to Stockholm, Sweden.
Holds a valid driver’s license and is comfortable with ~30% travel across the Nordics (store visits and occasional account HQ visits).
Embodies On’s Spirits. Check out our career page for more on these!

Our mission is to empower the global restaurant community to delight their guests, do what they love, and thrive.
To help achieve this mission, Toast is expanding into new countries and markets and so we are currently seeking an Account Executive to serve as a founding member of our Australian team.

As a founding Account Executive, this is an opportunity to build something meaningful from the ground up, where you will be an early member of our team that is transforming the way restaurants operate locally. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs in your local area.
By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customised solution that helps Melbourne businesses thrive. We need your passion and sales expertise to help us build the Toast brand in your geographic territory.
Your work will have an immediate and lasting impact, requiring a blend of operational sales expertise and a founder/entrepreneurial mindset. As the cornerstone of this function in this region, you will collaborate closely with the RVP and other stakeholders to lay the foundation for sustainable success in the Melbourne region.

The role offers autonomy, the chance to navigate ambiguity, and the opportunity to create frameworks, processes, and initiatives that will define the region’s growth for years to come.
This is a field sales opportunity. Candidates must live locally to Melbourne, Australia or be willing to relocate.

Generate list of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from prospecting, initial call to close (experience with self-sourcing clients is a huge plus)
Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs
Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery
Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities
Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Toast in the market

Strong communication, organisational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels
Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals
Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment
Self-motivated, creative, and flexible

We are seeking a Founding Junior Account Executive (AE) : a full-cycle seller who owns deals end to end, from first signal through closed-won. Junior means you are earlier in your career and the deal sizes you will own are smaller than what our senior AEs run. Founding means you are shaping how RegASK sells to mid-market, and what you build becomes the foundation.
We hire full-cycle on purpose. You will prospect into your own book, run first meetings, lead discovery, demo, navigate buying committees, and close. Our GTM Engineer feeds you warm, signal-driven opportunities; you turn them into revenue.
You will sell into regulatory affairs, quality, and compliance leaders at mid-market companies across pharma, medtech, food, cosmetics, and chemicals. Cycles are shorter than our enterprise motion but still require real consultative selling: these are senior buyers in regulated industries who expect you to understand their world.

Pipeline: Own a defined book of target accounts and a pipeline target. Hit it.
Full-Cycle Sales: Prospect, discover, demo, negotiate, and close. You own every stage.
Outbound Engine: Build pipeline through AI-augmented outbound (email, LinkedIn, phone, video) on accounts where the GTM Engineer surfaces strong intent signals.
Inbound Conversion: Qualify and convert inbound leads from website, events, content, and paid channels.
Discovery: Run consultative discovery with senior regulatory, quality, and compliance leaders. Understand their compliance pain, map it to our platform, and articulate ROI clearly.
Demo: Lead live product demos. Sales engineering supports on the complex ones.
Deal Navigation: Drive multi-stakeholder buying committees across regulatory, IT, procurement, and legal to closed-won.
CRM Hygiene: Maintain Salesforce as your source of truth. Every account, contact, activity, opportunity, and stage logged accurately.
Coaching: Leverage tools for call review and self-coaching. Contribute to peer development.
GTM Partnership: Work closely with the GTM Engineer to test new signals, plays, and sequences. Feed insights back into the engine.
Playbook: Help define the mid-market playbook: ICP refinement, qualification criteria, demo flow, objection handling, and pricing patterns that future AE hires will inherit.

2–4 years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with at least 12 months of closing experience as a full-cycle AE, AE Apprentice, or SDR-promoted-to-AE.
Track Record: Proven history of hitting and beating pipeline and revenue targets.
Consultative Selling: You can run a discovery call that surfaces real pain, not a feature demo. You can read a buying committee, adapt your approach, and know when to push and when to wait.
Modern Sales Stack Fluency: Hands-on with Salesforce, Gong Engage / Outreach / Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, or ZoomInfo. You can build a list, enrich it, sequence it, demo on Zoom, log it in CRM, and analyse it in Gong without needing a manual.
High AI Fluency: You use Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent daily as a force multiplier: account research, call prep, follow-up drafting, proposal generation, and competitive intel. You can write a prompt that gets a useful answer, spot when output is wrong, and build small AI-powered workflows that save you hours per week.
Strong Written Communication: You can write an outbound email that does not sound like a template and does not sound like AI wrote it either. You can write a proposal that gets signed.
Complex Buying Environments: Comfortable selling to lawyers, scientists, and regulatory professionals across multi-stakeholder committees involving regulatory, IT, procurement, and legal.
Domain Curiosity: You do not need a science degree, but you genuinely want to understand what our customers do. A motivation to build expertise quickly is essential.
Self-Direction: Comfortable operating without a playbook in a fast-moving, founding-stage environment.
Language : Native or fluent business English plus at least one European language (French, Spanish, Italian, or German) preferred, to support effective engagement with prospects and counterparts in the region.

Experience selling into pharma, medtech, food, cosmetics, or chemicals.
Background in regulatory affairs, life sciences, or compliance.
Prior experience as part of a founding GTM team.
Hands-on experience building or maintaining GTM workflows, custom CRM reports, or AI agents (Clay, Apollo, Salesforce, or equivalent).
Familiarity with EU regulatory frameworks (MDR, IVDR, REACH, EU AI Act, novel foods, or cosmetics regulation).

Impact: Your work compounds across the whole sales organisation. What you build today drives pipeline for the team every quarter going forward.
Growth: First-seat ownership, cutting-edge AI, and a culture that invests in learning and career development.
Culture: Diverse, agile, and mission-driven team across Canada, US, UK, EU, Singapore, Japan, and beyond.

High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

We're looking for an experienced, driven Senior Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across France's largest enterprises. Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value.

Comfort operating in an early‑stage, high‑growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly.
Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.
A hybrid of customer & product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction & scale
Native or full professional proficiency in French; strong English for internal collaboration

Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.
We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

As an Account Executive on the Commercial Scaled Install Base team, you will own a broad portfolio of existing Vercel customers and be responsible for both retaining and growing their business.
You will manage a high-volume book of accounts, balancing renewals, customer engagement, pipeline generation, and expansion opportunities. You will learn to recognize which customers need immediate attention, which signals point to growth, and where proactive outreach can create new commercial opportunites.
This is a true closing role. You will own revenue outcomes, run sales cycles, negotiate renewals and expansions, and build pipeline within your portfolio. You will also learn how to operate at scale, using customer data, automation, AI, and repeatable workflows to focus your effort where it can have the greatest impact.
This role is an ideal next step for an emerging seller who is ready to move into full-cycle account ownership. You may have developed your skills in an SDR or BDR role, renewals, account management, customer success, or another customer-facing position. What matters most is that you are commercially driven, eager to learn, and ready to take ownership of a number.
If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

Own the commercial relationship for a portfolio of existing Vercel customers.
Manage the renewal process from early preparation through negotiation and close, protecting recurring revenue and identifying risk before it threatens the relationship.
Build expansion pipeline by prospecting within existing accounts, reaching new stakeholders, developing champions, and uncovering new teams, applications, and workloads.
Run discovery, demonstrations, commercial conversations, and negotiations across a range of renewal and expansion opportunities.
Use customer signals, product usage, account data, and business context to prioritize the right action across a large portfolio.
Re-engage customers with limited activity or unclear growth indicators and develop hypotheses for how Vercel can create additional value.
Build relationships with developers, engineering leaders, product teams, procurement partners, and business stakeholders.
Partner with Solutions Architects, Developer Support, Customer Success, Product, and other internal teams to help customers achieve meaningful outcomes.
Maintain accurate account plans, opportunity details, forecasts, renewal timelines, and next steps in Vercel’s systems.
Use automation, AI, and repeatable workflows to operate efficiently and deliver thoughtful customer engagement at scale.
Share what you learn and help the team develop scalable plays for renewals, risk mitigation, customer re-engagement, and expansion.
Develop the technical and commercial skills required to grow into increasingly complex accounts and sales opportunities.

We are looking for someone who is ready to take the next step into full-cycle selling and account ownership.
You might be a great fit if you have developed your skills through an SDR or BDR role, renewals, account management, customer success, sales, or another customer-facing position.

About PostHog
Product development used to mean manually writing code, running analysis, diagnosing bugs, and rolling out changes using dozens of tools.
PostHog is the only platform that acts like a co-pilot for you (and your AI agents) to do it all – autonomously.
We started with open-source product analytics, launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort . We've since shipped more than a dozen products , including:
PostHog Code , the only AI devtool that understands your product, not just your codebase.
A built-in data warehouse , so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.
PostHog AI , an AI-powered analyst that answers product questions, helps users find useful session recordings, and writes custom SQL queries.

Product-led . More than 450,000 organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.
Default alive . Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.
Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.
We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible .
Things we care about
Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook . Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.
Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams and make product decisions . Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.
Shipping fast: Why not now? We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.
Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days , and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.
Ambition: We want to solve big problems. We strongly believe that aiming for the best possible upside, and sometimes missing, is better than never trying. We're optimistic about what's possible and our ability to get there.
Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.
Where is this role located
PostHog is a remote-first company, but this particular role needs to be based in the San Francisco Bay Area or elsewhere on the U.S. West Coast so you can work closely with the local tech market. If you’re based outside the Bay Area, you should be willing and able to travel regularly to San Francisco.
What you’ll be doing
We’ve proven that to be successful with our customers, we don’t need to stack multiple people all doing different roles for a customer.
With the right person working with them, who has the right balance of commercial and technical skills, we can get them excited enough to switch to PostHog and stick with us for a long time.
Technical Account Executives own the initial relationship with customers who get in touch via the website and want to speak with a human before signing up to PostHog. It’s early days, so you’ll cover the full spectrum of customers from high-velocity startups looking to move quickly, to more complex strategic engagements with Mid-Market/Enterprise customers.
They’ll also do warm outbound to users from large companies who sign up for PostHog themselves. Their focus is guiding the customer on their initial evaluation of PostHog as well as right-sizing their contract according to their needs.

Winning new business. You'll find your way to the right people at prospective customers — engineers, PMs, founders — and show them why PostHog beats whatever they're using now. You own the whole deal, first call to close and beyond, and you’re comfortable in your ability to meet and exceed a quarterly target.
Owning customer feedback and making sure it gets to the wider PostHog team. You’ll work directly with product teams, we don’t believe in bureaucracy here.
Being hyper responsive is a must . You need to feel like an extension of a customer’s existing team. We try to do as much customer comms in Slack as possible.
You’ll need to be an expert on all PostHog products , so that you can help customers see the value and adopt them.
Comfortable with outbound . You'll earn meetings through relevance and creativity – not through volume and pressure. We do weird outbound.
Switching contexts comfortably. Prospect and triage leads in the morning, enterprise evaluation in the afternoon, async Loom response to a customer question in between. You adjust tone, depth, and approach for each without losing quality.
Turning both inbound and outbound lead flow into a real pipeline that converts. Lots of people get in touch with us. Not all of them are deals. You should be able to tell the difference quickly, prioritize who PostHog will be a good fit for and close them efficiently.
This is a great role for someone who has been an AE before and has owned longer term customer relationships, but equally good if you have been a technical sales engineer who is confident in their ability to carry a quota
This role has a base salary component plus commission for hitting/exceeding sales targets. The salary in our compensation calculator is your expected total pay for on-target earnings.
What you won’t be doing
❌ Taking someone with you to every customer meeting. It’ll normally be you and the customer. Very occasionally you might bring a product engineer with you – e.g. if they are one of our first customers paying for a new product.
❌ Automating everything . A big part of this role will be ‘inefficiently’ building a lot of white glove, 1-1 customer relationships, so you can’t just rely on email sequences.

You’re able to go deep on understanding PostHog’s products , including more technical ones like feature flags and data warehouse. You don’t need to be a developer, but the ability to get into the details will give you confidence and really help you bring more value to customer conversations.

For example, you should be able to advise on configuration best practices to companies with multiple products and applications, advising on the pros and cons of different SDKs, and how to implement PostHog into their existing stack.

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place.
